direction: A living drop of pond water under a microscope: deep teal-navy depth, translucent jelly bodies lit from within, additive glow and slow caustic light. Everything is soft-edged and breathing; the season tints the whole water.

palette.name: deep
palette.use: Water depth, vignette, panel glass base

palette.name: teal
palette.use: Mid water, caustic base, panel fill

palette.name: algae
palette.use: Food, healthy energy bars, spring accent

palette.name: gold
palette.use: Food variety, crown glow, autumn tint, highlights

palette.name: violet
palette.use: Brain/genome accents, added things, winter hint

world.look: Vertical gradient from teal to deep navy, slightly lighter in the middle.
Slow drifting soft light ripples: a few large blurred bright polygons moving with sine offsets, additive at low alpha.
Tiny faint specks drifting slowly at the back.
Translucent radial colour washes (heat = rose-gold, cold = frost, poison = violet, dark = deep) with drifting particles.
Full-screen wash: spring pink-green, summer bright teal, autumn amber, winter pale blue, cross-fading.
Dark rounded vignette like a microscope lens edge.

entities.look: A soft translucent jelly circle with an inner darker nucleus and a glowing rim; parts drawn from simple shapes around it. Silhouette changes with genes so species look distinct at a glance.
parts: eye (white circle, dark pupil, small highlight)
entities.motion: Gently pulses with breathing scale; squashes along the thrust direction when moving; eyes look toward the nearest food or danger; flagella and cilia wave.

states.shows: Brief bright flash and a tiny scale bounce.
Pops from the parent with an expanding ring and sparkles.
Rose flash on the changed part for about a second.
Thin frost ring and a pulsing outline.

entities.look: Tiny glowing dots, algae-green or gold, with a soft halo.
A glowing orb tinted by its main property, with a dashed shimmering rim and its word in small text beneath.
entities.motion: Pulses slowly and sheds particles as it spreads.

feedback.effect: Ring pop and 4 sparkles at the child's position.
Rose flash on the changed gene and a line in the mutation log.
Creature dissolves into 5 motes that drift and become food.
Water tint cross-fades, step bar icon lights and a soft chime plays.
A banner slides in from the top with a soft glow: 'First eye!'.
Ripple rings and drifting particles at the drop point.
Screen shake and a colour flash scaled to the event.
Water slowly dims and goes still.

hud.look: A glass strip of four segments with petal, sun, leaf and snowflake icons; the current one glows and a caption line sits beneath.
A glass microscope-slide panel: generation, population, average fitness line graph, diversity number and a scrolling mutation log; collapsible.
Rounded glass pill buttons ADD, WORLD, SPEED, GUIDE, TREE, NEW, mute; inner glow, press squish.
A glass card with the chosen creature's genome strip of coloured beads, parents and fitness bars.
